Our Storage Solutions

Every home is unique. Our bespoke storage solutions are designed around your space, style, and storage needs.

Fitted Wardrobes

Custom-designed fitted wardrobes that maximise every inch of your space. From floor-to-ceiling designs to awkward corners.

Sliding Wardrobe Doors

Smooth-gliding sliding doors in a range of finishes including mirrored, glass, wood, and custom colours.

Walk-In Wardrobes

Luxury walk-in wardrobes designed around your lifestyle. Islands, lighting, accessories storage, and more.

Home Office Storage

Bespoke home office solutions with integrated desks, shelving, and cable management for the modern workspace.

Media & TV Units

Custom media walls and TV units with hidden cable management, sound system integration, and display shelving.

Home Libraries

Floor-to-ceiling bookcases and library systems with integrated lighting, rolling ladders, and display cabinets.

Why Choose The Recherche?

With over 15 years of experience creating bespoke storage solutions, we combine traditional craftsmanship with modern design innovation. Every project begins with understanding your lifestyle and ends with storage that transforms your daily life.

From initial consultation to final installation, our dedicated team manages every detail. We use only premium materials, precision engineering, and time-honoured joinery techniques to create fitted furniture that stands the test of time.

  • Free Design Consultation

    Our expert designers visit your home to measure, advise, and create 3D visualisations of your new storage.

  • UK Manufactured

    All our wardrobes are designed and manufactured in our UK workshop using sustainably sourced materials.

  • Professional Installation

    Our experienced fitting teams install your wardrobes with precision and care, typically in 1-2 days.

  • 10-Year Guarantee

    Peace of mind with our comprehensive 10-year guarantee on all fitted furniture and mechanisms.
